posts.author: Lionblaze
posts.body:
I'll start this by apologising if this is not the correct section to put this kind of post, or if I didn't post it correctly.
I'm trying to learn the engine, and I started following the tutorial by Driftwood Gaming (later to discover that they are in this forum as well). To start, I wanted to do these kinds of steps:
Making no more than 3 maps: a starting point, an inn, and the arena.
The starting point is the exit of a castle towards the arena, and on the left is the entrance to the inn. I put some NPCs, a vendor, and a nun who would be the saving point before the fight. I also put a dog, which in reality is a demon the players can fight.
Here, I wanted to make a door that would be locked, and that it would be open with the press of a switch nearby, reachable after doing some stuff with one or more NPCs.
The problem is that I tried to connect the door to the switch, but for some reason, the door appears only AFTER the switch is pressed, making it pointless. I tried to fix it, but gave up, opting for a simple key that would open the door. Again, the door appears only AFTER the key is obtained, and another problem appeared: I wanted to have the player try opening the door, realising that they would need a key, asking around about the key (with options for it appearing only after the door was examined), and other interactions here and there.
I watched the tutorial over and over, but I fail to see what I am doing wrong. Hell, I can't even find where the starting gold for the character is! To use the Inn or buy stuff, I had to make a chest with gold inside
I know that the problem is with the switches and the pages, but I feel like I'm missing many things in between.

posts.author: Caimcin
posts.body:
I can't say for certain without seeing a picture. But it sounds like you've set the door with the switch on the first page of the event.
It should go like this.
Door event:
1st page: no switch, "The door is closed" upon interaction
2nd page: "open door" switch (or whatever you call it) on the upper left part. Upon interacting with the door it teleports you.
You must set the door graphic in both pages!
Switch event: upon interaction: Turn "open door" switch on.
You've probably set what should be the 2nd page from my description as the 1st page in your event.
Let me know if that works.

posts.author: EbonSkolli
posts.body:
Hello!
One way to fix this is to make a new event tab. You'll see this towards the top of the pop-up window when you're making an event. Click the one that says New Event Page. This will make another event tab within the event. The first tab should be empty, save for the door sprite. When you go to the second tab/event page, this will need to be setup like the normal door event, plus your switch. You can even start this tab with some text indicating to the player that the door is being unlocked by their item before processing the door animation and transfer events.
Hope this helps!

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
You've set Switch 1 as a condition on that event page, so it won't show up in the game at all until Switch 1 is turned on. You'd need a second event page with that condition instead which represents the switch after it's been activated.
Just fyi, that's gone over in step 5 of the MZ tutorial
Good luck with your project.
